## What this changes

Moves the `agent-work-report` skill (the daily work report) from the PrivateRepoA repository into IronClaude, as PR C of issue 655 (tasks 20 to 24 of the build plan). Refs IronbellyOrg/IronClaude#655 (one piece of several; it does not finish the issue).

- `src/superclaude/skills/agent-work-report/`: SKILL.md, `config.json`, the 15 scripts and 7 templates copied from PrivateRepoA (a04c2754), formatted for ruff, plus the new `scripts/exclude.py`. No `plugins/superclaude/` copy.
- The skill now runs from the installed folder `~/.claude/skills/agent-work-report/` against the orchestrator repo: `repo_root()` is `$AWR_ROOT`, else `orchestrator_repo` of `~/.config/superclaude/issue-watch.json`; `config.json` has no `workspace` key. State stays at `.dev/coordinator/` inside the orchestrator repo.
- `exclude.py` (new Step 4b, between the sessions and `match.py`) leaves out every issue that has an entry file in `orchestrated/` while the run shows it open and assigned to the user, plus the pull request and sessions the entry names, and writes `excluded.json`. `compare.py`, `check.py` and `render.py` skip those urls.
- `run.py refresh [--run <run>]` (end of Step 12, and at each orchestrator milestone) rebuilds the shared `report.html` from the last daily report plus one block per entry file, with no model call, and never writes `<run>/report.html`, so `run.py gate` and `page.py` are unchanged. It also moves the entry of a closed or unassigned issue to `orchestrated/closed/` and deletes `closed/` and `info/` files older than `info_ttl_days`.
- `render.py entry` can take an entry file: every written part, `happened` and each session status come from it; the header line names the orchestrator.
- The lines `Why this reaches you:`, `Low-stakes options:` and `If you do not answer:` are in `needs-you-template.md` and `item-template.md`, and `check.py` fails a "Needs you" entry that lacks one.
- `tests/skills/test_agent_work_report.py`: the PrivateRepoA test moved (102 cases, all kept, layout assumptions repointed) plus 28 new cases. One entry added to the write-verb table of `tests/skills/test_worker_contract.py` for Step 14's commit of the skill's own state folder (a worker never runs this skill).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: one entry under Unreleased.

## What the owner does next

The skill runs from `~/.claude/skills/agent-work-report/` against the orchestrator repo as `AWR_ROOT`. Re-pointing the two automations `coordinator-morning-wake` and `coordinator-missed-check` to the installed `waker.py` is the owner's step O3 (task 44); nothing here touches them or the PrivateRepoA copy.

## Contract with PR B

The entry file `.dev/coordinator/orchestrated/<key>.json` is one flat JSON object: the slots of `common.WRITTEN` plus `suggested`, `priority_why` and `session_status`, and the fixed fields documented at the top of the entry section of `scripts/common.py`. The spec does not name the fixed fields, so those names are this PR's choice; PR B's `report-entry` must write the same ones.

## Open questions for the owner

1. The spec says `repo_root()` reads the path "from `repos.yaml`", but that file lives inside the repo it would locate. Built: `$AWR_ROOT`, else `orchestrator_repo` of the poll configuration, with `repos.yaml` checked to exist.
2. SKILL.md still says the session manager "is not built yet" and `waker.py hourly` names `/agent-coordinator`; no task of this PR names them, so they are as in PrivateRepoA.

## Verification

- `uv run pytest -q --tb=short -n 4 --maxfail=3 --ignore=tests/cli/test_verify_sync_hooks.py`: 23260 passed, 69 skipped. `tests/cli/test_verify_sync_hooks.py` (7), `tests/swarm -m imm` (84) and `-m inv` (107) pass.
- `make lint` passes; `uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/` names only the six Markdown files that already fail on master and are not touched here; `make verify-deps`, `make sync-dev` then `make verify-sync` and `git diff --check` pass.
- A throwaway-HOME `superclaude install` puts the skill at `~/.claude/skills/agent-work-report/`, `superclaude doctor --verbose` is healthy, and `run.py status` and `run.py refresh` run from the installed folder with `AWR_ROOT` set.
- No gate, `structural_checkers.py` or `*_validator.py` file is touched, so no Generator-Constraint section is needed.
